description:
Doctoral Programme Overview

Örebro University is looking for a doctoral student for the doctoral programme in gender studies at the School of Social Sciences and Media Studies. The programme will start in spring 2027. Gender studies at Örebro University is oriented towards social science studies and the department is a dynamic research environment marked by its strong international ties. The subject heads up the multidisciplinary research environment Centre for Feminist Social Studies. Grounded in feminist and political theory, the research at the department examines feminist theory and knowledge production, love and sexuality, feminist violence studies, sustainability and masculinity, politics and collective organising, as well as work and organisation.

Programme Details

The doctoral programme consists of courses and an independent research project that you will present in a doctoral thesis. The programme concludes with a doctoral degree and comprises 240 credits, which corresponds to four years of full-time study. The place on the programme is linked to a full-time doctoral studentship for the duration of the study programme.

Salary and Benefits

  • Initial salary for a doctoral studentship is SEK 32,300 per month.
  • Full-time doctoral studentship for four years of full-time study.
  • Specially tailored seminar series covering doctoral programme rules and careers to student welfare support and networking.
  • Thorough introduction to provide a solid foundation for doctoral studies.

Research Areas

  • Feminist theory and knowledge production
  • Love and sexuality
  • Feminist violence studies
  • Sustainability and masculinity
  • Politics and collective organising
  • Work and organisation

Eligibility Criteria

  • General entry requirements: A master's-level qualification, or at least 240 credits with 60 credits at master's level, or equivalent knowledge acquired in Sweden or abroad.
  • Specific entry requirements: At least 90 credits, including an independent project for a bachelor's degree in gender studies or a closely related subject.
  • The application of a gender perspective in previous academic works constitutes a strict requirement to be considered for the programme.

Application Process

All application documents and attachments should be written in Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, or English (or translated by an authorized translator). Required documents:

  • CV
  • Copies of original degree certificate(s) and official transcript(s) of records for bachelor's degree
  • Copies of original degree certificate(s) and official transcript(s) of records for master's degree
  • Independent project/degree project at the master's level
  • Outline of preliminary PhD project including information about topic/research field, aim, theory, methods/material, and relevance for the gender studies research field (max 3 pages)
  • Other relevant documents, course and degree certificates, academic papers, and relevant publications.

Application dates

MilestoneDate
Application Deadline28 September 2026
Programme StartSpring 2027
Duration4 years full-time

Official Links

  • Doctoral Studies in Gender Studies: https://www.oru.se/english/study/doctoral-studies/subjects-and-general-syllabuses/gender-studies/
  • Application Portal: https://web103.reachmee.com/ext/I003/354/apply?site=12&lang=UK&validator=fe5113edcdf298b951d93f1ee85f632e&job_id=12845

Important Notes

  • The position is a fully funded doctoral studentship with a monthly salary.
  • The programme is conducted in English.
  • Applicants must demonstrate a gender perspective in previous academic works.
